name: Home Assistant — Todo
description: Items from a Home Assistant todo list — built-in shopping list, Google Tasks, Microsoft To-Do, CalDAV, anything exposed as a todo.* entity. Four selectable visual directions: Refined / Geometric / Swiss / Data. Lead with the items needing action; show due dates when the integration sets them. Requires HA 2024.5+ (the todo.get_items service with return_response). Requires the Home Assistant Core plugin.

cell_options.name: entity_id
cell_options.label: List
cell_options.help: Which HA todo entity to read. Shows every todo.* entity discovered on your HA instance.

cell_options.name: max_items
cell_options.label: Items shown
cell_options.help: How many items to display. The full count appears in the header meta.

cell_options.name: include_completed
cell_options.label: Include completed items
cell_options.help: Off by default — completed items are listed after the needs-action ones, struck through.
